layerDefinitions(

 techPurposes(
 ;( PurposeName          Purpose#   Abbreviation )
 ;( -----------          --------   ------------ )
  ( fillDummy            100        fdm          )
  ( mark                 101        mrk          )
 ) ;techPurposes

 techLayers(
 ;( LayerName            Layer#     Abbreviation )
 ;( ---------            ------     ------------ )

  ( OD                   2          OD           )
  ( PO                   3          PO           )
  ( PP                   4          PP           )
  ( NP                   5          NP           )
  ( CO                   10         CO           )
  ( M1                   11         M1           )
  ( VIA1                 12         V1           )

  ( M3                   15         M3           )
  ( VIA3                 16         V3           )  ; REQ-001
  ( M4                   17         M4           )  ; REQ-002

 ) ;techLayers

 techLayerPurposePriorities(
 ;layers are ordered from lowest to highest priority
 ;( LayerName            Purpose    )
 ;( ---------            -------    )
  ( NW                   drawing    )
  ( OD                   drawing    )
  ( PO                   drawing    )
  ;( PO                   pin        )  ; RETIRED REQ-007
  ( PP                   drawing    )
  ( NP                   drawing    )
  ( CO                   drawing    )
  ( M1                   drawing    )
  ( M1                   pin        )
  ( M1                   fillDummy  )
  ( VIA1                 drawing    )
  ( M2                   drawing    )
  ( M2                   pin        )

  ( VIA2                 drawing    )
  ( M3                   drawing    )
  ( M3                   pin        )
  ( VIA3                 drawing    )  ; REQ-001

  ( M4                   pin        )  ; REQ-003
  ( text                 drawing    )

 techDisplays(
 ;( LayerName    Purpose      Packet          Vis Sel Con2ChgLy DrgEnbl Valid )
 ;( ---------    -------      ------          --- --- --------- ------- ----- )
  ( NW           drawing      NW_drw          t t t t t )
  ( OD           drawing      OD_drw          t t t t t )
